title: JPMRC 27-01: 1-21 Infantry Regiment Conducts Medical and Unmanned Aerial  System Rehearsals
description: U.S. Soldiers assigned to 1st Battalion, 21st Infantry Regiment, 2nd Mobile Brigade, 25th Infantry Division, conduct medical rehearsals and unmanned aerial system  flight rehearsals as part of Joint Pacific Multinational Readiness Center (JPMRC) rotation 27-01 at Helemano Military Reservation, Hawaii, Nov. 5, 2026. JPMRC 27-01 integrates U.S. forces alongside military members from the Republic of Korea, Singapore, France, New Zealand, Japan, and the Maldives to refine joint capabilities and rehearse tactics, techniques, and procedures required to dominate jungle and archipelagic terrain during large-scale combat operations. The exercise underscores the U.S. Army's commitment to ensuring regional security and strengthening partnerships in the Indo-Pacific area of responsibility. (U.S. Army video by Sgt. Duke Edwards)
keywords: tactical training, Unmanned Aerial System (UAS), JPMRC, large scale combat operations, Medical Rehearsals
